messages:
Anya: Quick proposal 9: run a 2-week pilot to improve postmortem follow-up closure velocity. Minimal template + 15m weekly huddle + bot digest + 72h remediation-claim rule. Start next Monday?
Sam: yes, please keep it lightweight. I can wire the JQL and bot digest. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Agree. We should make remediation_owner explicit in the postmortem so IC != remediation owner by default. Last time that caused ambiguity.
Anya: Template (tiny):
```
- action_id: AF-100
- remediation_owner: @Sam
- created_by: @Anya
- created_ts: 2026-04-01
- due_date: 2026-04-08
- priority: P2
- status: open / blocked / done
- validation: 7d post-deploy error rate < 0.1%
- recurrence_flag: true/false
- linked_ticket: https://rwd/jira/AF-100
- notes: one-line blocker
```
Lee: add "validation_window" field (e.g., 7d) and a short "relationship" tag (SLO/billing/customer). Helps triage.
Maria: I'll run a 15-min weekly closure huddle (Mon 11am) to triage blockers. Only owners attend. Keeps it short.
Sam: I'll create saved JQL: `project = AF AND status != Done AND due_date < now()` and hook weekly digest to #eng-oncall.
Jordan: Metrics for pilot: closure_velocity (actions_closed/week), median_time_to_close, percent_recurrence. I'll build a dashboard.
Anya: Policy: remediation_owner must be claimed within 72h of postmortem publish; otherwise auto-escalate to oncall lead. Avoids unowned items.
Sam: Automation idea: incident-bot creates followup tasks from postmortem items, sets owner if provided; if unassigned, mark unassigned and ping #eng-oncall. Low lift.
incident-bot: Heads-up: 2 followups older than 14 days (AF-088, AF-091).
Lee: For triage, add a tiny score: priority + recurrence + SLO impact => triage_rank. Keeps queue ordered.
Maria: Calendar invites sent for Mon 11am for the next two weeks. Owners get pinged when actions assigned.
Jordan: I'll share starter dashboard link by Friday.
Sam: I'll post bot config + saved JQL tomorrow.
Anya: Pilot owners: Sam (automation), Jordan (metrics/dashboard), Maria (huddle). I'll handle 72h escalation enforcement. Start: 2026-04-06, review: 2026-04-20.
Lee: Small habit: when closing an action, include a 1-line "how verified" sentence. Makes closures objective.
Sam: ack. Also will send weekly overdue digest and an alert when >7d past due.
Jordan: If recurrence_flag=true, we'll tag the postmortem and run a 30-day pattern review.
Anya: Goal: faster closures, clear ownership, early detection of recurring patterns. I'll post final template + links in #eng-oncall after updates.
Maria: :white_check_mark:
Lee: :thumbsup:
Sam: :rocket:
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: followup pilot starts 2026-04-06.
Anya: Closing thread; will reopen with templates/links.
